records.text: The Department of Defense used a canary trap with slight variations in recipients' emails to identify leakers.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: we were very quickly able to determine that the Department of Defense is using what is known as. ... known as a canary tactic, to root out would-be leakers, right? ... they are able to issue these slight variations to everyone's email. ... it helps them identify immediately the source of a leak.

verification.notes: Canary traps are a real leak-detection technique, but the transcript ties this specific Department of Defense use claim to Owens inference from undisclosed email variations. No Department of Defense record or independent authentication was found, and the White House Military Office denied knowledge of the alleged communications.
